Effect: Choose and perform one of the cheers below. You may perform each Cheer only once per Scene.

» Don’t Stop Now!: All allies on the Field gain Temporary Hit Points equal to your Charm Rank and become Motivated. @UUID[Compendium.ptu.effects.Item.gLauExV34WJ0NvRX]

» I Believe In You!: All allies on the Field gain a +2 Bonus to evasion for 1 full round and become Cheered. @UUID[Compendium.ptu.effects.Item.cNMIhl2yvy7hWc6d]
@UUID[Compendium.ptu.effects.Item.pZO043r8mNBFfbCD] 

» Show Your Best!: Choose Def, or Sp.Def, all allies on the Field gain +1 CS in the chosen Stat and become Excited. @UUID[Compendium.ptu.effects.Item.gRcD70tgms6rGKOm] @UUID[Compendium.ptu.effects.Item.R4VCsfCLQffgSWFO]

» You Can Do It!: Choose Atk, Sp.Atk, or Spd, all allies on the Field gain +1 CS in the chosen Stat and become Encouraged. @UUID[Compendium.ptu.effects.Item.d3TZl3w59v3WY9Ce] @UUID[Compendium.ptu.effects.Item.qRDaSypajeZhawMD]
